verdicts.flaw_description: The purchase counts are computed on a filtered slice of the funnel: they "cover the sessions that reached the new page" while "a quarter of each segment dropped out before checkout", so the 25% who never got as far as the new checkout page are dropped from the numbers, and this surviving three-quarters is compared against the whole segment a month earlier.

The particulate numbers are a per-protocol slice: "The figures cover the runs with the upgraded filter in service, and a quarter of each stack's runs were made with the filter bypassed", so the worst quarter of runs is excluded from the post-upgrade figure while the "same unit a quarter earlier" baseline is not similarly filtered.

The abduction averages are restricted to compliers: they "cover the patients who kept up the home exercises" while "a quarter of each intake let the home exercises lapse", so the lapsed quarter is dropped and a self-selected, better-adhering group is compared against the full ward a quarter earlier.

The germination rates cover only the best-treated trays: they "cover the trays sown from seed that took a full coat" while "about a fifth of each lot's trays were sown from partly coated seed", so that fifth is excluded from the post-coating figure but is presumably inside the previous season's baseline.
